Class GameUI

java.lang.Object
gamemode.gym.ui.GameUI
public class GameUI extends Object
Builds and manages all visual elements for the gym rhythm mini-game.

The UI is composed of two stacked layers:

  • Game layer — the background, lane backdrop, and falling notes (notes are added and removed here by NoteManager).
  • Overlay layer — the judgment line, score, timer, combo, multiplier, and back button, drawn on top of the game layer every frame.

Combo and multiplier text are horizontally centered over the lane center and update dynamically as their layout bounds change.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameUI

      public GameUI(int width, int height, int noteSize, int startX, javafx.scene.image.Image backgroundImage, Runnable onBack)
      Constructs the GameUI, laying out all visual elements and wiring the back button to the provided callback.
      Parameters:
      width - the width of the game canvas in pixels
      height - the height of the game canvas in pixels
      noteSize - the size of each note in pixels, used to calculate lane width
      startX - the X coordinate where the note lane begins
      backgroundImage - the image displayed as the game background
      onBack - the action invoked when the back button is pressed

  • Method Details

    • animateCombo

      public void animateCombo()
      Plays a brief scale-up-and-back animation on the combo text node, providing visual feedback on a successful hit. The text pulses to 130% of its original size over 120 milliseconds.

    • showJudgmentHit

      public void showJudgmentHit()
      Flashes the judgment line to full opacity. Should be called each time the player presses a lane key.

    • fadeJudgmentLine

      public void fadeJudgmentLine()
      Gradually reduces the judgment line's opacity by 0.05 per call, down to a minimum of 0.3. Should be called once per frame to produce a smooth fade-out after a hit.
